name: Informatics
tagline: Think in loops and logic? Time to compete like it.
description: Sharpen your algorithmic thinking, data structures, and competitive programming skills for IOI and national coding rounds.

international.label: IOI
international.honestNote: Nepal is not yet an IOI member and has never participated — verified against the official 118-country member list (stats.ioinformatics.org). NOI names its Top 4 the 'IOI Nepal Team' and runs a C++ training camp for them, but IOI accreditation is the missing step. Every other South Asian country (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka) is a member.

rounds.name: NOI Round 1 — District Level Competition
rounds.format: Each district hosts its own contest; cutoff determined independently per district; Top 3 per district awarded. Any programming language allowed.
rounds.eligibility: Nepali citizens in Grades 8–12, not enrolled in undergraduate studies (students born in Nepal studying abroad are eligible)
rounds.registration: Free of charge; all official updates sent by email

rounds.name: NOI Round 2 — Provincial Level Competition
rounds.format: District qualifiers compete per province; independent cutoff per province; Top 3 per province awarded. Any programming language allowed.

rounds.name: NOI Round 3 — Pre-Finals
rounds.format: Top ~50 students nationwide; selection criteria and problem set standardized nationwide; Top 25 advance.

rounds.name: NOI Round 4 — Finals
rounds.format: Top 25 compete; Top 10 = National Winners (medals, certificates); Top 4 = official 'IOI Nepal Team'. Problems comparable in difficulty and style to the IOI.

rounds.name: IOI Training Camp
rounds.format: For the Top 4 exclusively. Curriculum exclusively in C++ (IOI's mandatory language): advanced algorithms, data structures, optimisation, competition strategy.

rounds.name: IOI
rounds.format: 2 days × 3 tasks × 5 h · C++ only · 100 points per task · 600 total · subtask scoring
rounds.eligibility: Not yet reachable — Nepal's IOI membership is pending (see the honest note on the International level)
